title: Family Legal Secretary - St Albans
description:
Family & Childcare Legal Secretary - St Albans, Hertfordshire Location: St Albans, Hertfordshire
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Full Time Permanent
Benefits: Excellent Benefits Package Training & Development

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an organised and enthusiastic Family & Childcare Legal Secretary to join the expanding Family Law department of a highly regarded Legal 500 law firm based in St Albans.

This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of a busy and supportive team, providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to solicitors specialising in Family Law, Childcare and Legal Aid matters.

Previous experience within Family or Childcare Law would be advantageous, although applications are welcomed from experienced Legal Secretaries with a background in other practice areas who have a genuine interest in developing their careers within Family Law.

The firm offers a friendly working environment, modern paperless systems, ongoing training and excellent opportunities for career development.

The Role
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to Family and Childcare Solicitors.
- Producing legal correspondence and documentation using digital dictation and copy typing.
- Managing diaries, appointments and meetings for fee earners.
- Liaising with clients, Counsel, experts, courts and other third parties.
- Assisting with Legal Aid applications and CCMS matters.
- Processing experts' invoices and fee notes.
- Maintaining electronic files and ensuring accurate document management.
- Handling telephone enquiries and providing excellent client care.
- Ensuring compliance with internal procedures and confidentiality requirements.

About You
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary or in a similar legal support role.
- Experience within Family Law, Childcare Law or Legal Aid would be desirable.
- Fast and accurate typing skills, ideally including digital dictation.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage competing priorities in a busy legal environment.
- A professional, approachable manner and commitment to excellent client service.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and Christmas/New Year leave.
- Additional birthday leave.
- Increasing annual leave entitlement with service.
- Employer pension contributions.
- Optional healthcare scheme.
- Electric vehicle scheme.
- Modern IT systems and firm laptop.
- Ongoing training, mentoring and career development.
- Annual salary reviews and appraisals.
- Summer and Christmas social events.
- Friendly, supportive and established team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Legal Secretary looking to specialise or further develop their career in Family and Childcare Law within a respected and growing law firm.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary - Family Law Department

Location: Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire

Working Hours: Monday to Friday -37 Hour working week

Working Arrangement: Full-time, office-based (no remote working)

Annual Leave: 26 days plus bank holidays

Salary: £28,000 + PA

About the Opportunity

We are currently supporting our client, a well-established law firm based near Hatfield, Hertfordshire, in their search for an experienced and organised Legal Secretary to join their busy Family Law Department.

This is an excellent opportunity for a professional individual who enjoys working in a varied and fast-paced legal environment. You will play an important role in supporting the family law team with day-to-day administration tasks, case management, client communications and contributing towards the smooth running of the department.

Employee Benefits

Our client offers a competitive employee benefits package, which includes:
- 26 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays
- Workplace pension scheme.
- Opportunities to develop your legal knowledge and gain further experience within family law.
- A friendly, supportive and professional working environment.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Life assurance.

Key Responsibilities

As a Legal Secretary, your responsibilities will include:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to the Family Law Department.
- Handling enquiries from new and existing clients via telephone, email and face-to-face meetings.
- Providing information about the firm's legal services, including explaining potential fees and costs where appropriate.
- Responding to client queries in a professional, sensitive and timely manner, including those involving potentially confidential matters.
- Assisting with the management and progression of legal cases, ensuring documentation and correspondence are accurately maintained.
- Preparing, processing and organising legal letters, documents and general correspondence.
- Verifying client identification documents and reviewing supporting documentation, in accordance with internal procedures.
- Maintaining accurate client records and ensuring all files and confidential information are securely stored and correctly organised, including managing in-bound and out-bound post.
- Supporting fee earners and other members of the department with general administrative duties.
- Using internal case management systems and Microsoft Office applications to maintain accurate records and support daily activities.
- Prioritising workloads effectively to ensure deadlines are met and the department operates efficiently.

Skills and Experience Required
- Previous experience working within a Family Law Department would be beneficial, ideally in a legal secretarial or administrative support role.
- A good understanding of the confidential and sensitive nature of family law matters.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and confident telephone manner.
- A personable and empathetic approach when dealing with clients.
- Strong organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise workloads and work effectively towards deadlines.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
- A positive, flexible and supportive approach to working as part of a team.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive and established legal team where you can utilise your existing secretarial skills while continuing to develop your knowledge of family law.

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary who enjoys working with people, takes pride in delivering excellent administrative support and thrives in a busy, client-focused environment, we would like to hear from you.

title: Litigation Legal Administrator
description:
We are working with a specialist legal practice based close to Hertford who are looking to recruit a Property Litigation Legal Administrator to join their growing team. This is an opportunity for someone with legal experience to develop their career within property litigation, supporting solicitors with a high volume of residential and commercial claims.

The role would suit someone who enjoys managing a busy workload, communicating with clients and taking ownership of their cases. Property litigation experience would be beneficial, although candidates from other areas of law who have a genuine interest in moving into property litigation will also be considered.

Typical Duties:
- Manage a high volume of residential and commercial claims relating to service charges, ground rent, possession and breaches of lease.
- Prepare and process claim forms, court applications, consent orders and supporting documentation.
- Support solicitors with possession claims, forfeiture proceedings and enforcement action.
- Manage case progression, maintain accurate records and ensure court deadlines and daily targets are met.
- Communicate with clients and other stakeholders by telephone and email, including managing calls from the enquiry line and resolving queries.

Candidate Requirements:
- At least one year of experience working within a legal environment.
- Property litigation experience would be preferred, although candidates from other legal backgrounds will be considered.
- A genuine interest in developing a career within property litigation.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of work accurately.
- Confident communication skills and a willingness to handle regular telephone enquiries.

This is an office-based close to Hertford, working within a large, friendly team with plenty to learn. The role offers the opportunity to develop your legal knowledge, take ownership of your own cases and gain experience supporting solicitors across possession and enforcement matters.

If you are looking to develop your legal career and are interested in property litigation, we would be keen to hear from you.

Please apply via the advert or contact Calum at Eclectic Recruitment for more information.

We endeavour to reply to every candidate, every time, but if you haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email to discuss other potential opportunities.
